claim: stru < 拉丁 struere「堆叠、建造」

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from cōnstruō 'to heap together', from com- 'together' + struō 'to heap up, pile'

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from Latin structūra 'a fitting together, adjustment, building, erection, a building, edifice, structure', from struere

records.name: Wiktionary
records.quote: from verb obstruere, from against + struere 'pile up, build'

note: construct / structure / obstruct 三条独立条目均给出 struere/struō；instruct 词条只有 īnstrūctus，未展开 struere。
